image.facts: Medium shot, screen-left to screen-right: Wit, Irin, seated on the foot of the bed. Wit looks straight at camera, a white smartphone loosely held in his right hand on his right thigh, left hand on his left thigh; Irin leans slightly toward him, hands clasped in her lap, looking at him.
